ambitions.name: A nest egg
ambitions.text: Hold $1,000 in cash across your hideouts
ambitions.logbook: A thousand dollars put by in the strongbox.

ambitions.name: Money in the strongbox
ambitions.text: Hold $10,000 in cash across your hideouts
ambitions.logbook: Ten thousand dollars put by. Nobody on the lake knows where.

ambitions.name: A fortune
ambitions.text: Hold $50,000 in cash across your hideouts
ambitions.logbook: Fifty thousand dollars put by: a fortune, and every cent of it hidden.

ambitions.name: Infamous
ambitions.logbook: Infamous now. The waterfront knows the name.

ambitions.name: A legend of the lake
ambitions.logbook: A legend of the lake. They tell it in every saloon from Duluth to the Soo.

ambitions.name: Slipped the Morrill
ambitions.text: Escape the revenue cutter Morrill three times
ambitions.logbook: Slipped the Morrill a third time. Her captain will be hearing about it.

ambitions.name: At large
ambitions.text: Be Most Wanted in a region and stay free for a week
ambitions.logbook: A week Most Wanted, and still free.

ambitions.name: As good as your word
ambitions.logbook: Twenty-five cargoes delivered on time. The agents ask for you by name.

ambitions.name: Friend of the house
ambitions.text: Be a friend of the house (Standing 90) in three ports
ambitions.logbook: A friend of the house in three ports.

ambitions.name: Smart passages
ambitions.text: Deliver three contracts in record time (half the time allowed)
ambitions.logbook: A third cargo in record time. The shippers talk of nothing else.

ambitions.name: The gales of November
ambitions.text: Make port through a November gale, the storm signal flying
ambitions.logbook: Came in through a November gale with the storm signal flying.

ambitions.name: Two hideouts
ambitions.text: Hold both hideout sites, Stockton Island and Siskiwit Bay
ambitions.logbook: Two hideouts on the lake now, and the law knows of neither.

ambitions.name: A proper place
ambitions.text: Raise a hideout of 500 pieces or more
ambitions.logbook: Five hundred pieces at one hideout: a proper place, not a shack.

ambitions.name: Built her ourselves
ambitions.text: Build a schooner on your own slipway and launch her
ambitions.logbook: Launched a schooner off our own slipway.
